scenes.heading: INT. NURSERY - CHRISTMAS MORNING
scenes.purpose: Introduce splendid new Velveteen Rabbit in stocking; brief love then forgotten amid presents
visual_beats: Christmas stocking by hearth with Rabbit wedged at top holding holly
Boy pulls Rabbit free and hugs hard
Other stocking gifts spill out
Aunts and Uncles rush in; tissue paper; Rabbit set aside forgotten on floor

scenes.heading: INT. NURSERY - DAY
scenes.purpose: Rabbit snubbed among superior toys; Skin Horse explains what REAL means
visual_beats: Rabbit on cupboard floor among mechanical toys and model boat and wooden lion
Rabbit settles beside bald patched Skin Horse near fender
Dialogue on Real: love over time, shabbiness, lasting forever
Rabbit sighs at thought of growing shabby

scenes.heading: INT. NURSERY - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Nana gives Rabbit to Boy for bed; nights of hugs and tunnels; fur begins to wear from love
visual_beats: Night-light on mantel; Nana hurries bedtime; china dog missing
Nana swoops cupboard and drags Rabbit by ear into Boy's arms
Tight hugs, rolled on, pushed under pillow; later whispered tunnels
Rabbit snuggles under chin all night; time-lapse of shabbier fur, unsewn tail, pink nose rubbed off

scenes.heading: EXT. GARDEN - SPRING DAY
scenes.purpose: Spring garden play; Rabbit left in dew; Nana grumbles he is only a toy
visual_beats: Wheelbarrow rides, grass picnics, fairy huts under raspberry canes
Rabbit dives earthy into flower-bed burrows
Boy called to tea; Rabbit left on lawn after dusk soaked in dew
Nana with candle rubs him on apron corner and calls him a toy

scenes.heading: INT. NURSERY - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Boy fiercely declares Bunny is REAL; Rabbit gains knowing look
visual_beats: Boy sits up arms out demanding Bunny
Boy insists he is not a toy he is REAL
Love stirs; boot-button eyes gain wisdom and beauty
Next morning Nana notices knowing expression

scenes.heading: EXT. WOOD - SUMMER EVENING
scenes.purpose: Wild rabbits mock missing hind legs and wrong smell; Rabbit left alone then carried home; grows still shabbier yet loved
visual_beats: Boy nests very shabby Rabbit in tall bracken then wanders off
Two furry wild rabbits emerge, hop, inspect, mock no hind legs and smell
Boy's footsteps scatter them with white-tail flash; Rabbit calls after them
Boy carries him home; weeks of further wearing while still beautiful to Boy

scenes.heading: INT. NURSERY - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Boy's scarlet fever; Rabbit stays hidden under bedclothes through long illness until fever turns
visual_beats: Boy flushed burning talking in sleep; body heats Rabbit
Strange people come and go; light burns all night
Rabbit hidden unmoving under bedclothes whispering garden plans
Fever turns; Boy sits with picture-books Rabbit cuddled close

scenes.heading: INT. NURSERY - BRIGHT MORNING
scenes.purpose: Recovery morning; Boy carried out in shawl; windows open
visual_beats: Windows wide open sunny air
Pale Boy wrapped in shawl carried toward balcony
Rabbit tangled in bedclothes head peeping

scenes.heading: EXT. BALCONY - DAY
scenes.purpose: Seaside plans and doctor orders old Bunny burned as scarlet fever germs
visual_beats: Boy on balcony in shawl looking out
Voices on seaside tomorrow disinfection and burning bed toys
Nana asks about old Bunny
Doctor orders burn at once get a new one

scenes.heading: EXT. END OF THE GARDEN BEHIND THE FOWL-HOUSE - DAY
scenes.purpose: Rabbit sacked with rubbish behind fowl-house for morning bonfire; Boy gets new bunny
visual_beats: Rabbit put in sack with picture-books and rubbish
Carried to end of garden behind fowl-house
Sack left untied; gardener busy elsewhere
That night Boy sleeps elsewhere with new white plush bunny dreaming of seaside

scenes.heading: EXT. END OF THE GARDEN BEHIND THE FOWL-HOUSE - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Lonely tear; mysterious flower; Nursery Magic Fairy appears and takes Rabbit to be Real to everyone
visual_beats: Moonlit Rabbit head through sack shivering threadbare
Memories of garden wood Skin Horse; real tear falls
Emerald-leaved golden-cup flower grows and opens
Fairy in pearl and dew-drops kisses him explains nursery magic and flies him to wood

scenes.heading: EXT. WOOD - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Fairy delivers Rabbit to wild rabbits; final kiss grants hind legs and living fur; joyful first leaps
visual_beats: Moonlit glade; wild rabbits dance then ring Fairy
Fairy sets Rabbit down and bids him run and play
Nose tickle; hind toe scratch reveals real hind legs and shiny brown fur
Joyous leaping whirling; Fairy gone; Real Rabbit at home

scenes.heading: EXT. WOOD - SPRING DAY
scenes.purpose: Next spring Boy glimpses marked familiar rabbit and wonders if old Bunny; never knows for certain
visual_beats: Warm spring; healthy Boy plays in wood
Two rabbits peep from bracken; one brown one with faint spots under fur
Familiar soft nose and round black eyes
Boy wonders softly if old Bunny; rabbits slip back into bracken
